title: Product (L4, stable half)
description: Identity and composition. Price, stock and marketplace URL live in pricing.json so that a price refresh never dirties a composition record. Composition is NUMERIC in compound units — that is what makes the UL ledger and cost-per-effective-dose computable.

strain.description: Required where the compound is strainSpecific.

splittable.description: Can one serving be halved in practice? A scoop with a half-mark or a scored tablet can; a softgel, sealed capsule or gummy cannot. The nearest-half rounding rule falls back to whole units when this is false — without this flag the rounding rule can silently prescribe half a capsule.

qualitySignal.description: NOT a gate in the MVP — the quality floor is effective-dose-met only. Displayed to the user and available for a future verified-dose floor.

suitableFor.description: Overrides the ingredient's list where a specific SKU differs (e.g. a gelatin capsule on an otherwise vegan ingredient).
